answer: The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, voided if the audit panel is not diverse. The thread is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the juniper. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the lagoon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
